edits.new:
Scenario: AC14 A rule naming the clear identity number is refused at load (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a masking file holds a rule that names the clear identity number
    When the masking file is loaded
    Then the system refuses the load with message MSG-P1-002
    Then the rule is not stored and `id_no_last4` is the clearest identity value a rule can name

  Scenario: AC15 A masking file naming an unknown role code or a field id that is not personal is refused in full (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a masking file names a role code the `role` table does not hold, or a field id whose `is_personal` is not true
    When the masking file is loaded
    Then the system refuses the whole masking version with message MSG-P1-002 and names the field
    Then the version in force stays unchanged

  Scenario: AC16 An approved version is published with no personal value, every operation demands its declared right, and no business value is written in code (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a matrix or masking version reaches Approved
    Then `rwb.access.AccessPolicyChanged.v1` is published on `rwb.access.events.v1` with the version, the change kind and the effective date, and no personal value
    Given a caller without the declared right calls an operation of this story
    Then the guard refuses the call before the handler runs
    Given the letters, scopes, approver roles, refresh interval, versions and effective dates
    Then each is read from a row or a parameter and none is written in code
